name: codeshare
description: P2P code sharing for local AI assistants — host exposes an authenticated MCP server over TLS; guest's AI connects as a remote MCP client.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codeshare/shared && npm run build -w @codeshare/host && npm run build -w codeshare
scripts.test: npm run test -w @codeshare/shared && npm run test -w @codeshare/host && npm run test -w codeshare
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @codeshare/shared && npm run typecheck -w @codeshare/host && npm run typecheck -w codeshare
